about: What the Safe2Ride site sends the Safe2Ride API and what comes back. Keep this file identical in both repos (the site's tests compare them when both are checked out side by side). Bump v for any change an older site couldn't handle.

weather.about: The site fetches the weather (Open-Meteo hourly, wind in mph) and sends it as-is. Values may be null; the API never reads a gap as safe.

POST /describe/route.about: An AI-written 'what to expect' paragraph. Called only when the rider taps Description. cps, wx, now and tz as for /assess/route; dep is the departure shown. The API re-runs the rules itself. Names are cleaned and shortened; the rider's own address is never sent (start is an area name).
POST /describe/route.surfaces: percent of the distance per class: quiet, path, busy, g1, g2, g3, unknown

errors.409: version mismatch: { error, code: "version" }; the site asks the rider to refresh
errors.502: describe only: the AI service failed or didn't answer: { error }
errors.503: describe only: descriptions are switched off or over budget: { error }
